NGEX.TO.reason: Valiente Resources spin-out: 1/5 VALX share per NGEx share. Spin value per NGEx share = 3.51 / 5 = C$0.702 (VALX first close, 16 Nov 2026); factor = 1 - 0.702 / 20.21 (NGEX close, 13 Nov 2026) = 0.965265. Standard spin-off price adjustment (same method as a special dividend).

NVPT.TA.reason: Yahoo history unit switch: closes before 18 May 2026 are in shekels, later ones in agorot (ILA, 1/100 shekel), so earlier closes are scaled x100. Not a corporate action.
